adaptation: Keep Soulia's existing shell, Cairo/Inter and forest green. Use a ruled sheet, quiet rows and one primary action. No replacement of the app navigation design.
inventory: Objects: supplier label batches, products, print requests, linked purchase invoices.
Batch fields: ID, product name/SKU, creation date/issuer, quantity, printed coverage, linked and unused counts.
Origin and linked invoices remain available in a separately addressable detail screen.
Quantities: 1–1000 per batch; 100 labels per single range request, or 1000 labels across up to 20 selected batches per atomic bulk print request.
Batch list pages contain 12 rows; product result pages contain 8 explicit choices, with no hidden 80-product cutoff.
Operators prepare labels for suppliers and later receive physical pieces through the existing invoice flow.
Most common jobs: create a batch, find an earlier batch, print its range, check its provenance.
Product identity is the real product name and SKU; reserved piece identities retain the ordinary U format.
Production UI reads existing APIs. Test fixtures are isolated from production storage.
Keep one document scroll; mobile tables become rows with all fields retained.

questions.list: Which batch do I need to open or print?
questions.new: Which product and how many unique labels do I need?
questions.detail: What happened to this batch and which label range should I print?

face: Existing Soulia frame, dark green action and the product name/SKU as the leading identity.
signature: Batch lineage: reserved count, print coverage, activation count and linked invoices alongside the numbered print range.
critique: Removed stacked modal sections and the second scrolling batch list; each operation now has a route and explicit Back action.
Moved product results ahead of the summary on phones; choosing a result takes the operator to the quantity field.
Preserved matching column edges, neutral count typography and a single filled primary action per screen.
Counts come from API fields; printed coverage may include linked pieces and is not a separate disjoint stock category.
Zero counts show zero; missing timestamps/origins show a dash; failures show Retry rather than an empty stock message.
Real app shell screenshots reviewed at 1440, 768 and 390, in addition to isolated skill inspector captures.
No charts or fabricated operational totals were introduced.

inspector.new: 0 FAIL, 1 WARN (hero-void): the single-product test fixture produces a short form. The sheet ends with its content; filling the remaining viewport with invented products or stretching the form would worsen this task screen.

validation.supplier_feature: 18 of 18 Chromium integration tests passed. Bulk tests cover cross-page selection, discontiguous unprinted labels, one popup, explicit reprint confirmation, retry after an uncertain committed response, selection preservation and reduced motion.
validation.backend: 48 of 48 isolated MongoDB integration tests passed. Bulk tests cover multiple products and more than 100 labels, confirmation, stale review and concurrency rejection, replay, permissions, linked exclusions and quantity limits.
validation.app_shell: supplier-labels-page.cjs passed direct routes, refresh, browser Back, bulk review and pixel bounds at 1440/768/390, with supplier module loading deliberately delayed to test startup races.
validation.broader_inventory_ui: 33 passed, 11 failed in inventory-unit-ui.spec.ts. Failures include removed scanner selectors, label count expectations that omit batch covers, default size expectations and warehouse fixture differences; this is not a clean full-system run.
validation.concurrent_template_edits: The shared inventory label template changed during this work. The final template moves the footer outside the product text and validates footer fitting separately; supplier print and overflow tests were rerun against that current template. No baseline source files were left behind.

bulk_review.question: Which exact identities will this combined print job send, and does it include duplicates?
bulk_review.default: Unprinted only, based on recorded requests; explicit warning and checkbox for reprints. Both options exclude linked identities.
bulk_review.motion: 160ms opacity feedback on route content, subtle button hover/press feedback, no animated scroll during route replacement; reduced-motion removes transitions.
bulk_review.inspector: 0 FAIL, 1 hero-void WARN on the one-batch fixture. The short form ends at its data; no artificial rows or stretched panels were added to fill the viewport.
bulk_review.manual_review: Real app desktop/tablet/phone screenshots reviewed, including reprint warning, confirmation and numeric totals. Shortened option text to fit phone controls and fixed checkbox/name overlap.

fixture_note: Basket, numbered Basket rows and Brown jute coaster screenshots use isolated HTTP fixtures. No fixtures are bundled into production UI; no production sample data needs replacing.
